description: This file defines classes and functions for parsing, representing, and comparing software version strings following PEP 440 standards. It includes the Version class, parsing utilities, and internal data structures for version components.

classes.name: _Version
classes.description: NamedTuple storing parsed version components such as epoch, release, pre, post, dev, and local segments.

classes.name: InvalidVersion
classes.description: Exception raised when a version string does not conform to expected format.

classes.name: _BaseVersion
classes.description: Base class providing comparison and hashing functionality for version objects.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Main class representing a parsed and comparable version, with properties for version components and string representations.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a version string into a Version object, raising InvalidVersion if invalid.

methods.name: _parse_letter_version
methods.description: Helper to parse pre-release and post-release letter and number components.

methods.name: _parse_local_version
methods.description: Helper to parse local version segments into tuples.

methods.name: _cmpkey
methods.description: Generates a comparison key tuple for sorting version objects according to PEP 440 rules.
